system.name: Charon
system.one_liner: the graph-based frontend of an LLM performance simulator: trace native PyTorch models into forward / backward graphs and transform them with compiler-style passes

components.name: Native PyTorch Models
components.role: (a) input box with framework logos and a rotated layer strip (Embedding, Transformer, ..., LM Head)

components.name: torch.compile / torch.fx.symbolic_trace
components.role: (a) tracer applied to a single transformer block

components.name: Raw Forward Graph
components.role: (a) traced graph plus dummy input tensor and loss function

components.name: Torch AOT Autograd / Graph Optimize + Refine
Joint Graph (FWD + BWD) / Torch Partitioner / BWD Postprocess
components.role: (a) split into forward and backward graphs

components.name: Optimization Passes
components.role: (b) operator rewrite, operator fusion, ..., recompute / reorder

components.name: Parallelism Passes
components.role: (b) shard pass (TP/EP/SP), pipeline parallel pass, ..., data parallel pass

content.key_idea: The frontend turns a native model into forward and backward operator graphs and treats every optimization, parallelism and analysis as a graph pass.
content.reading_order: (a) left-to-right then up and across to the joint graph and down into the two graphs; dash-dot rule; (b) left bookend -> three pass groups -> right bookend.

palette.used_for: joint graph header, graph containers, rotated bookend bars

style.stroke: dark ink ~0.65 pt; dotted outlines for the dummy-input box and the pass regions; dash-dot rule between panels
style.font: Calibri Bold, rotated text on layer strips and bookend bars, 5-7 pt at print size
style.arrows: short black arrows, elbow arrows between pass groups

encoding.color_means: blue = forward, pink = backward; pale region tint = pass family
encoding.line_style_means: dotted region = a family of interchangeable passes; vertical ellipsis = more passes
reusable_patterns: pass pipeline between two rotated grey bookend bars
pass family as a pale dotted region with white rounded steps
weaknesses: single-column print: the step labels print near 5-6 pt

evidence: the frontend turns the simulation input into a computational graph
optimizations and parallelisms are abstracted as graph manipulation passes

summary: Panel (a) traces one transformer block of a native PyTorch model with torch.compile / fx into a raw forward graph, runs AOT autograd and refinement to a joint forward + backward graph and partitions it into forward (blue) and backward (pink) graphs. Panel (b) passes the traced graphs through optimization, parallelism and analysis pass groups to the simulation results.
summary_zh: 前端图，两个面板用点划线隔开：(a) 从原生模型追踪出前向图，再拆成前向和反向两张图；(b) 三组编译式 pass（优化、并行、分析）夹在两根竖排灰色长条之间。
notes: Style reference for the named style 'charon'.
